name: Demonic Kiss: Unleashed
source:
You've applied to a high paying job with your eyes closed, and now you're paying the price. 

Just as easily as you would stub your toe, you became a demon contractor. 

Great! Now you're a wanted criminal! 

...Maybe you should read the job description more carefully next time.

[From [url=https://deepblaq.itch.io/dk1]itch.io[/url]]
